elements.description: An API reference's side navigation: endpoints grouped by resource, with method badges, a filter and the current page.

properties.name: description
properties.description: A quiet line under the title: the version, the base URL

properties.name: groups
properties.description: The resources and their endpoints, in order

properties.name: current
properties.description: The current endpoint's id – aria-current="page". Set by a click unless a tc-navigate listener calls preventDefault()

properties.name: query
properties.description: The filter's text. Changed by typing unless a tc-query-change listener calls preventDefault()

properties.name: showPaths
properties.description: Show each endpoint's path instead of its name. Changed by the Paths switch unless a tc-show-paths-change listener calls preventDefault()

properties.name: collapsed
properties.description: The ids of closed groups. Changed by opening and closing unless a tc-collapsed-change listener calls preventDefault()

properties.name: hideFilter
properties.description: Hide the filter field (for a short reference)

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-navigate
events.description: An endpoint was chosen ({ id, href, endpoint, current }: ApiNavNavigate); cancelable – prevented, a link isn't followed and `current` stays

events.name: tc-query-change
events.description: The filter changed ({ query }: ApiNavQueryChange); cancelable – prevented, `query` stays

events.name: tc-show-paths-change
events.description: The Paths switch was pressed ({ showPaths }: ApiNavShowPathsChange); cancelable – prevented, `showPaths` stays

events.name: tc-collapsed-change
events.description: A group was opened or closed ({ collapsed, id, open }: ApiNavCollapsedChange); cancelable – prevented, `collapsed` stays

functions.name: apiMethodTone
functions.description: The tone a method's badge takes: reads in blue, creates in green, changes in amber, deletes in red

functions.name: apiEndpointMatches
functions.description: Whether an endpoint matches a filter: every word must be in its name, path or method

props.name: current
props.description: The current endpoint's id – controlled when given; your router sets it

props.name: defaultCurrent
props.description: The current endpoint at first, when `current` isn't controlled; then a click moves it

props.name: onNavigate
props.type: (id: string, href: string | undefined, event: CustomEvent<ApiNavNavigate>) => void
props.description: An endpoint was chosen; call `event.preventDefault()` to route a link yourself instead of following it

props.name: query
props.description: The filter's text – controlled when given

props.name: defaultQuery
props.description: The filter's text at first, when `query` isn't controlled

props.name: onQueryChange
props.description: Called with the filter's new text

props.name: showPaths
props.description: Paths instead of names – controlled when given

props.name: defaultShowPaths
props.description: Paths at first, when `showPaths` isn't controlled

props.name: onShowPathsChange
props.description: Called when the Paths switch is pressed

props.name: collapsed
props.description: The ids of closed groups – controlled when given

props.name: defaultCollapsed
props.description: The closed groups at first, when `collapsed` isn't controlled

props.name: onCollapsedChange
props.description: Called with the closed groups after one is opened or closed

features.name: light-dark()
features.why: Every colour token is a light / dark pair; without it no colour token resolves.

features.name: color-mix()
features.why: Tints and washes mixed from the tokens.

features.name: Container size queries
features.why: Components adapt to the width they're given, not the window's.

features.name: :has()
features.why: Layout and state that depend on what's inside a part (an icon present, a focused field).

features.name: :is() and :where()
features.why: Every rule is keyed on :where() so the page can override it.

features.name: adoptedStyleSheets
features.without: Each element type's CSS goes into one <style> element in <head> instead – it looks and works the same.

features.name: forced-colors media query
features.without: In a forced-colours mode the browser's own adjustments apply, without the components' fixes.

features.name: overscroll-behavior: contain
features.without: Scrolling past the end of a list carries on scrolling the page.
